# java.test options: `report = "tests"`, `args` reaching the launcher, test
# resources on the class path, custom `sources`, a failing test, no test
# classes, and no launcher.
[!exec:javac] skip

# A stand-in for the JUnit console launcher: it calls each test class's
# static check(String[]) with the launcher's arguments, and reports the
# results as JUnit's XML reporter would.
bit launcher

bit unit
stdout 'unit ▶ junit execute --include-tag=fast src/test/java'
stdout 'PASS demo\.ArgsTest/check\(\)'
stdout 'PASS demo\.ResourceTest/check\(\)'
stdout 'unit ✔ ok'

bit unit
! stdout 'PASS'

# A changed test resource reruns the tests.
cp fixture.changed unit/src/test/resources/fixture.txt
! bit unit
stdout 'fixture\.txt holds other data'

# A failing test fails the target and shows its failure.
! bit broken
stdout 'FAIL demo\.BrokenTest \(.*1 failed\)'
stdout 'java\.lang\.AssertionError: expected 1 but was 2'
stdout 'broken ✘'

# Compiled tests without a test class: the launcher finds none, and its
# output explains the failure.
! bit empty
stdout 'No tests found'

# Without a launcher on the class path or in a lockfile.
! bit nolauncher
stderr 'there is no JUnit console launcher \(org\.junit\.platform\.console\.ConsoleLauncher\)'

-- BUILD.bit --
explicit launcher = java.library {
  dir = "launcher"
}

explicit unit = java.test {
  dir       = "unit"
  classpath = launcher.classpath
  args      = ["--include-tag=fast"]
  report    = "tests"
}

explicit broken = java.test {
  dir       = "broken"
  sources   = "tests"
  classpath = launcher.classpath
}

explicit empty = java.test {
  dir       = "empty"
  classpath = launcher.classpath
}

explicit nolauncher = java.test {
  dir = "unit"
}
-- launcher/src/main/java/org/junit/platform/console/ConsoleLauncher.java --
package org.junit.platform.console;

import java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException;
import java.lang.reflect.Method;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class ConsoleLauncher {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Path classes = null;
        Path reports = null;
        for (String arg : args) {
            if (arg.startsWith("--scan-class-path=")) classes = Paths.get(arg.substring(18));
            if (arg.startsWith("--reports-dir=")) reports = Paths.get(arg.substring(14));
        }
        List<String> tests = new ArrayList<>();
        Path root = classes;
        try (var files = Files.walk(root)) {
            files.filter(f -> f.toString().endsWith("Test.class"))
                .forEach(f -> tests.add(root.relativize(f).toString().replace(".class", "").replace('/', '.')));
        }
        if (tests.isEmpty()) {
            System.err.println("No tests found");
            System.exit(2);
        }
        StringBuilder xml = new StringBuilder("<testsuite name=\"JUnit Jupiter\">");
        boolean failed = false;
        for (String test : tests) {
            xml.append("<testcase name=\"check()\" classname=\"").append(test).append("\" time=\"0.01\">");
            try {
                Method check = Class.forName(test).getDeclaredMethod("check", String[].class);
                check.setAccessible(true);
                check.invoke(null, (Object) args);
            } catch (InvocationTargetException e) {
                failed = true;
                xml.append("<failure message=\"failed\">").append(e.getCause()).append("</failure>");
            }
            xml.append("</testcase>");
        }
        Files.createDirectories(reports);
        Files.writeString(reports.resolve("TEST-junit-jupiter.xml"), xml.append("</testsuite>"));
        System.exit(failed ? 1 : 0);
    }
}
-- unit/src/test/java/demo/ArgsTest.java --
package demo;

import java.util.Arrays;

class ArgsTest {
    static void check(String[] args) {
        if (!Arrays.asList(args).contains("--include-tag=fast")) {
            throw new AssertionError("missing --include-tag=fast in " + Arrays.toString(args));
        }
    }
}
-- unit/src/test/java/demo/ResourceTest.java --
package demo;

import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

class ResourceTest {
    static void check(String[] args) throws Exception {
        try (InputStream in = ResourceTest.class.getResourceAsStream("/fixture.txt")) {
            if (in == null) throw new AssertionError("fixture.txt is not on the class path");
            String text = new String(in.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8).trim();
            if (!text.equals("fixture data")) throw new AssertionError("fixture.txt holds " + text);
        }
    }
}
-- unit/src/test/resources/fixture.txt --
fixture data
-- fixture.changed --
other data
-- broken/tests/demo/BrokenTest.java --
package demo;

class BrokenTest {
    static void check(String[] args) {
        throw new AssertionError("expected 1 but was 2");
    }
}

class Helper {
}
